name: Jevin Hodge
summary: Jevin Davon Hodge is an American political strategist, business executive, nonprofit leader, and former politician. A member of the Democratic Party, he served in the Arizona House of Representatives for the 8th legislative district from February 2 to March 19, 2024. He previously served as vice chairman of the Arizona Democratic Party and was the Democratic nominee for Arizona's 1st congressional district in the 2022 United States House of Representatives election, losing to incumbent Republican David Schweikert by fewer than 3,200 votes.
